annotations.title: One fund or share: what it is and holds

description:
One fund or share on its own, without a portfolio: name, type, exchange, yearly cost
        when the issuer publishes it, measured return, volatility and worst fall, and
        for a fund its largest holdings and sectors. Use it before deciding whether a
        ticker belongs in a measurement; for only today's price use last_price, for
        what a whole portfolio owns through its funds use look_through. The ticker
        takes the exchange suffix for non-US listings (VWCE.DE, IWDA.AS); when a
        ticker is not found, search_symbols finds the right one.
